newsitem.title: USA: Russian mom who left son in park may lose custody.
newsitem.headline: Russian mom who left son in park may lose custody.

text.p: A Russian woman accused of leaving her 7-year-old son alone in a city park was ordered by a family court on Wednesday to leave the boy in foster care while her case is reviewed.
Tatiana Glotova, 25, of suburban Paterson, N.J., was arrested on June 10 after leaving her son Dennis alone in Madison Square Park while she worked at a photo and design studio 16 blocks away.
A judge said she could visit her son at the foster care agency, but put off until June 25 a decision on whether Glotova will be permanently reunited with him.
Glotova is charged by the family court with neglect and by a criminal court with endangering the welfare of a child.

"The boy will remain in foster care while we review the situation and investigate the circumstances in which she left the child alone," Maggie Lear, a spokeswoman for the Administration for Children's Services said.
Witnesses who alerted police said the boy was alone in the park anywhere from two to six hours without food or drink.
Glotova, who came to the country from Russia five years ago, is separated from her husband. Lawyers for the boy's father have told the judge he wants custody of the child.
An upstate New York boarding school for children from troubled families has also offered to care for the boy.
